package cmd

import (
 "fmt"
 "context"
 "github.com/your-org/los-cp/migrations"
 "github.com/your-org/los-cp/internal/platform/audit"
 "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
 "github.com/your-org/los-cp/internal/platform/database"
 "encoding/json"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestGeneratedCRUD(t *testing.T) {
 db, err := database.OpenDatabase()
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 sqlDB, err := db.DB()
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 defer sqlDB.Close()
 tx := db.Begin()
 if tx.Error != nil { t.Fatal(tx.Error) }
 defer tx.Rollback()
 schema := fmt.Sprintf("modkit_test_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
 if err := tx.Exec("CREATE SCHEMA " + schema).Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := tx.Exec("SET LOCAL search_path TO " + schema).Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

 entries,err:=migrations.Files.ReadDir("sql");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 for _,entry:=range entries {
  raw,err:=migrations.Files.ReadFile("sql/"+entry.Name());if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  up:=strings.Split(strings.Split(string(raw),"-- +goose Up")[1],"-- +goose Down")[0]
  if err:=tx.Exec(up).Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
 router := NewRouter()
 router.Use(func(c *gin.Context){
  c.Request=c.Request.WithContext(audit.WithIdentity(c.Request.Context(),audit.Identity{ActorID:"test-user",TenantID:"tenant-1",RequestID:"request-1"}))
  c.Next()
 })
 for _, initialize := range moduleInitializers {
  if err := initialize(tx, router); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 }
 checks := []struct{ method, path, body string; status int; contains string }{
  {"GET", "/healthz", "", 200, "ok"},
 {"GET", "/sales/applicant", "", 404, ""},
 {"GET", "/underwriting/decision", "", 404, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer", "", 200, "[]"},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", "{", 400, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", "{}", 400, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", `{"id":"c1","name":"Alice","active":true,"balance":12}`, 201, "Alice"},
  {"POST", "/sales/customer", `{"id":"c1"}`, 409, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 200, "Alice"},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer", "", 200, "Alice"},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/c1", `{"id":"wrong"}`, 400, ""},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/c1", `{"name":"","active":false,"balance":0}`, 200, `"balance":0`},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 200, `"active":false`},
  {"PUT", "/sales/customer/missing", "{}", 404, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/missing", "", 404, ""},
  {"POST", "/sales/order", `{"id":"s1"}`, 201, "s1"},
  {"GET", "/sales/order/s1", "", 200, "s1"},
  {"DELETE", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 204, ""},
  {"GET", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 404, ""},
  {"DELETE", "/sales/customer/c1", "", 404, ""},
 }
 for _, check := range checks {
  request := httptest.NewRequest(check.method, check.path, strings.NewReader(check.body))
  request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  response := httptest.NewRecorder()
  if err := tx.SavePoint("request").Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
  if response.Code >= 400 { if err := tx.RollbackTo("request").Error; err != nil { t.Fatal(err) } }
  if response.Code != check.status || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), check.contains) {
   t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %d %s; want %d containing %q", check.method, check.path, response.Code, response.Body.String(), check.status, check.contains)
  }
 }

 // Exercise both the module's primary entity and an additional entity.
 for _, path := range []string{"/sales/order", "/sales/customer"} {
  for _, id := range []string{"p3", "p1", "p2"} {
   request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", path, strings.NewReader(fmt.Sprintf(`{"id":%q}`, id)))
   request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
   if response.Code != 201 { t.Fatalf("seed: %d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String()) }
  }
  total := int64(3)
  if path == "/sales/order" { total = 4 } // Existing s1 from CRUD checks.
  for _, test := range []struct {
   query string
   offset, size int
   ids []string
  }{
   {"?offset=0&limit=2",0,2,[]string{"p1","p2"}},
   {"?offset=2&limit=2",2,2,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p3"} }()},
   {"?offset=1&limit=2",1,2,[]string{"p2","p3"}},
   {"?offset=99&limit=2",99,2,[]string{}},
   {"",0,20,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p1","p2","p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p1","p2","p3"} }()},
   {"?limit=100",0,100,func() []string { if total == 4 { return []string{"p1","p2","p3","s1"} }; return []string{"p1","p2","p3"} }()},
  } {
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", path+test.query,nil))
   var result struct {
    Items []struct { ID string }
    Offset int
    Limit int `json:"limit"`
    Total int64
   }
   if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   if response.Code != 200 || result.Offset != test.offset || result.Limit != test.size || result.Total != total || result.Items == nil || len(result.Items) != len(test.ids) {
    t.Fatalf("%s%s: unexpected pagination: %s",path,test.query,response.Body.String())
   }
   for i,id := range test.ids { if result.Items[i].ID != id { t.Fatalf("unexpected order: %s",response.Body.String()) } }
  }
  for _, query := range []string{
   "?offset=-1", "?offset=abc", "?offset=", "?limit=",
   "?limit=0", "?limit=-1", "?limit=101", "?limit=abc",
   "?offset=9999999999999999999999999", "?limit=9999999999999999999999999",
  } {
   response := httptest.NewRecorder()
   router.ServeHTTP(response,httptest.NewRequest("GET",path+query,nil))
   if response.Code != 400 { t.Fatalf("%s%s: expected 400, got %d",path,query,response.Code) }
  }
 }

 var entriesAudit []audit.Entry
 if err:=tx.Where("entity_id = ?","c1").Order("id").Find(&entriesAudit).Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if len(entriesAudit)!=3{t.Fatalf("want create/update/delete audit only, got %+v",entriesAudit)}
 for i,action:=range []string{"create","update","delete"}{
  entry:=entriesAudit[i]
  if entry.Action!=action || entry.ActorID!="test-user" || entry.TenantID!="tenant-1" || entry.RequestID!="request-1" || entry.OccurredAt.IsZero(){t.Fatalf("invalid audit: %+v",entry)}
 }
 // Audit insertion failure must roll back the business write.
 if err:=tx.Exec("ALTER TABLE platform_audit_entries RENAME TO audit_unavailable").Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 response:=httptest.NewRecorder()
 request:=httptest.NewRequest("POST","/sales/customer",strings.NewReader(`{"id":"must-rollback"}`))
 request.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
 router.ServeHTTP(response,request)
 if response.Code!=500{t.Fatalf("want audit failure, got %d",response.Code)}
 var count int64
 if err:=tx.Table("sales__customer").Where("id = ?","must-rollback").Count(&count).Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if count!=0{t.Fatal("business write committed without audit")}
}

// Exercise Goose itself, including idempotent up and reversible down, in an isolated schema.
func TestVersionedMigrations(t *testing.T){
 db,err:=database.OpenDatabase();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 sqlDB,err:=db.DB();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 sqlDB.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
 defer sqlDB.Close()
 schema:=fmt.Sprintf("modkit_migrations_%d",time.Now().UnixNano())
 if err:=db.Exec("CREATE SCHEMA "+schema).Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer func(){
  if err:=db.Exec("DROP SCHEMA "+schema+" CASCADE").Error;err!=nil{t.Error(err)}
 }()
 if err:=db.Exec("SET search_path TO "+schema).Error;err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 provider,err:=migrations.Provider(sqlDB);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 first,err:=provider.Up(context.Background());if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if len(first)<3{t.Fatal("expected bootstrap, audit and entity migrations")}
 again,err:=provider.Up(context.Background());if err!=nil || len(again)!=0{t.Fatalf("up is not idempotent: %v",err)}
 if err:=migrations.Check(context.Background(),sqlDB);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,err:=provider.Down(context.Background());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,err:=provider.Up(context.Background());err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
